title: A ring of perceptual color (d3-color)
description: D3 Color converts CIELCH coordinates to display RGB. Gray crosses mark colors outside the sRGB gamut before display clipping.
description_ko: D3 Color가 CIELCH 좌표를 화면 RGB로 변환해요. 회색 십자는 화면 색역 밖의 색을 표시하고, 실제 색은 표시 가능한 범위로 잘라요.
prompt: A ring of perceptual color. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
summary: A ring of perceptual color. Change the controls to explore the actual algorithm.
